page.description: Devuan editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: Debian with sysvinit instead of systemd. Pick the live desktop, the smaller live image or the installer, then write the 64-bit image to a stick.
pros: Live desktop and installer images from the same release.
Plain sysvinit, so the boot sequence stays readable.
Direct upgrades from Daedalus and migrations from Debian trixie are documented.
cons: Only amd64 images are published for Excalibur.
The project publishes no end-of-life date.
The 6.1.1 point refresh has no separate announcement date; the page shows the 6.0 suite date.
The Commons screenshot shows an older Xfce desktop.
page.previewNote: A stock screenshot of a Devuan Xfce desktop from Wikimedia Commons. It is not 6.1.1 and not a ROMinit recording: no image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted for this page.

shot.alt: Devuan Xfce desktop with the application menu open
shot.caption: Stock screenshot of a Devuan Xfce desktop · not this build, no USB written, no boot tested.

page.status: One path per image: desktop live, minimal live or netinstall, written with dd or any image writer. Writing erases the stick; the installer then partitions or erases the target disk. 6.0 Excalibur was released 2025-11-02; 6.1.1 is a later point refresh with no separately published date.

editions.name: Desktop live

editions.usbNote: amd64 only. Write it with dd or any image writer; writing erases the stick.

editions.name: Minimal live
editions.description: A smaller live system without the full desktop, for rescue or a minimal install.
editions.usbNote: amd64 only. Write it with dd or any image writer; writing erases the stick.

editions.name: Installer (netinstall)
editions.description: The classic installer image: it installs the base system and fetches the rest from Devuan's mirrors.
editions.usbNote: amd64 only. Write it with dd or any image writer; writing erases the stick.
